This test-only correction closes those boundaries while preserving and strengthening the normal and linked Git invariants and the sole source allowlist.
rationale: Freeze the fourth independently reviewed IDQ-MVP-080 operational-provider contract before the sole owned source exists. The production seam is now module-owned subprocess.Popen and the local fake is installed only by the tests. The suite binds canonical AUTH-02 bytes to reloaded durable queue job authority, exact ordered single-use markers, fresh QOBS and live identity/capacity state, strict temporary no-oneOf provider schemas, bounded binary stream capture, process-group cleanup, exact capacity accounting, fixed raw-free UNKNOWN WorkResults, independently recomputed receipt hashes, and SQLite-persisted result/receipt equality. Fresh RED evidence is 271 failed and 29 passed across 300 collected tests; the 29 source-independent controls also passed directly. The queue hash is local control-plane authenticity, not cryptographic issuer proof, and this fake-Popen baseline proves neither provider execution, account authentication, daemon integration, deployment, nor release readiness. No provider, network, credential, source, documentation, deployment, or release action is performed; the only eligible later source remains scripts/multiagent_idq_mvp_080_operational.py.
